writeup: TIC 230067194 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 0.7946 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing 0.99 percent dimming, with a strong signal-to-noise ratio of 112.9 in the box least squares search. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed a centroid offset of 5.9 arcsec from the target position, with a peak signal-to-noise of 10.7 in difference imaging. No secondary eclipse was detected in the data. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, and the machine-learning classifier assigned it a score of 0.82, indicating high probability as a real target. This object passed all automated data quality checks.
